title: Donning the Yellow Robe: Rise and Fall of the Song
synopsis: In 960, Zhao Kuangyin donned the yellow robe and founded the Song dynasty, marking the beginning of a period of extraordinary cultural and scientific advancement in Chinese history.

series.title: The Splendor of the Song Dynasty

fullText.simplified:
黄袍加身——宋朝的起点与终点

    公元960年，距离唐朝灭亡已经半个世纪了。由于唐朝末年军阀割据，此时的中国仍然四分五裂。然而，北方的后周政权正在悄然发生变化。
    这一年，北方契丹人入侵。年仅八岁的皇帝派大将军赵匡胤迎敌。军队走到陈桥驿时停下休息，赵匡胤召集将士商议接下来的计划。吃饱喝足后，他就休息了。不久，他被将士们高呼“万岁”的声音吵醒了。睁眼一看，发现自己身上穿着一件代表皇帝身份的黄袍。
    原来，很多将士担心小皇帝不能管理国家，更担心国家再次陷入混乱。他们觉得赵匡胤才是最能保护国家的人，所以偷偷决定让他当皇帝。赵匡胤一开始不想接受，但大家一直跪着喊“万岁”。他多次拒绝，最终在众人的坚持下接受了这个安排。
    第二天，他带着军队回到后周的首都。他下令不得伤害皇室成员，也不能打扰老百姓。于是，他顺利进入开封，建立了宋朝。
    赵匡胤在“黄袍加身”当了皇帝以后，马上开始了统一全国的计划。但慢慢地，他开始担心：当年自己能轻松当上皇帝，会不会以后也有人用同样的方法，把他赶下台？
    第二年，他请一些部下喝酒。喝着喝着，他有点伤感地说：“唉，没有你们，我就不能当皇帝。但现在我当了皇帝，却总是睡不好觉，还是以前当将军更轻松！”部下们不明白，问：“皇上为什么睡不好？”赵匡胤半醉半醒地说：“我这个皇位，谁不想要呢！”大家听懂了他的意思，纷纷表示愿意交还兵权，回家养老。于是，赵匡胤给了他们很多金子和土地，让他们安心退休。这就是历史上著名的“杯酒释兵权”。
    为了不走唐朝因为将军太强而灭亡的老路，宋朝采取了不同于前朝的国家治理方式：重文轻武，实行文官主政。朝廷很重视科举考试，给文官高收入、高地位，并确立了“不轻易杀文官”的制度。
    在这样的制度下，宋朝掀起了学习的风潮，文化得到了极大的发展。据统计，中国现在课本中的古代文学，有一半左右是宋代的。不仅如此，宋朝的商业和科技也非常发达，世界上最早的纸币就是在宋朝出现的。中国的四大发明中，火药、活字印刷和指南针都在宋朝得到重大突破。据部分学者估算，宋代的GDP曾占据全球经济总量的约一半，堪称当时世界上最富裕的国家之一。
    然而，在这片文化与经济的繁荣背后，也埋藏着危机。由于长时间压制武将，宋朝的军队变得很弱。为了和平，朝廷不得不经常给北方的民族送“岁币”，但始终无法收复失地。军队太弱，后来也成了宋朝灭亡的一个重要原因。
    “黄袍加身”不仅是一场权力更迭，更深刻地影响了宋朝的国家治理模式。我们可以用拟人化的方式来形容中国不同朝代的风格：如果唐朝是热情活泼、喜欢运动的女孩，那么宋朝就是一个安静、有文化、有气质的大家闺秀。但是，这位闺秀最后没有过上幸福的生活。因为没有强大的国防，当战火来临时，她的优雅生活也就结束了。
fullText.traditional:
黃袍加身——宋朝的起點與終點

    公元960年，距離唐朝滅亡已經半個世紀了。由於唐朝末年軍閥割據，此時的中國仍然四分五裂。然而，北方的後周政權正在悄然發生變化。
    這一年，北方契丹人入侵。年僅八歲的皇帝派大將軍趙匡胤迎敵。軍隊走到陳橋驛時停下休息，趙匡胤召集將士商議接下來的計劃。吃飽喝足後，他就休息了。不久，他被將士們高呼“萬歲”的聲音吵醒了。睜眼一看，發現自己身上穿著一件代表皇帝身份的黃袍。
    原來，很多將士擔心小皇帝不能管理國家，更擔心國家再次陷入混亂。他們覺得趙匡胤才是最能保護國家的人，所以偷偷決定讓他當皇帝。趙匡胤一開始不想接受，但大家一直跪著喊“萬歲”。他多次拒絕，最終在眾人的堅持下接受了這個安排。
    第二天，他帶著軍隊回到後周的首都。他下令不得傷害皇室成員，也不能打擾老百姓。於是，他順利進入開封，建立了宋朝。
    趙匡胤在“黃袍加身”當了皇帝以後，馬上開始了統一全國的計劃。但慢慢地，他開始擔心：當年自己能輕鬆當上皇帝，會不會以後也有人用同樣的方法，把他趕下臺？
    第二年，他請一些部下喝酒。喝著喝著，他有點傷感地說：“唉，沒有你們，我就不能當皇帝。但現在我當了皇帝，卻總是睡不好覺，還是以前當將軍更輕鬆！”部下們不明白，問：“皇上為什麼睡不好？”趙匡胤半醉半醒地說：“我這個皇位，誰不想要呢！”大家聽懂了他的意思，紛紛表示願意交還兵權，回家養老。於是，趙匡胤給了他們很多金子和土地，讓他們安心退休。這就是歷史上著名的“杯酒釋兵權”。
    為了不走唐朝因為將軍太強而滅亡的老路，宋朝採取了不同於前朝的國家治理方式：重文輕武，實行文官主政。朝廷很重視科舉考試，給文官高收入、高地位，並確立了“不輕易殺文官”的制度。
    在這樣的制度下，宋朝掀起了學習的風潮，文化得到了極大的發展。據統計，中國現在課本中的古代文學，有一半左右是宋代的。不僅如此，宋朝的商業和科技也非常發達，世界上最早的紙幣就是在宋朝出現的。中國的四大發明中，火藥、活字印刷和指南針都在宋朝得到重大突破。據部分學者估算，宋代的GDP曾佔據全球經濟總量的約一半，堪稱當時世界上最富裕的國家之一。
    然而，在這片文化與經濟的繁榮背後，也埋藏著危機。由於長時間壓制武將，宋朝的軍隊變得很弱。為了和平，朝廷不得不經常給北方的民族送“歲幣”，但始終無法收復失地。軍隊太弱，後來也成了宋朝滅亡的一個重要原因。
    “黃袍加身”不僅是一場權力更迭，更深刻地影響了宋朝的國家治理模式。我們可以用擬人化的方式來形容中國不同朝代的風格：如果唐朝是熱情活潑、喜歡運動的女孩，那麼宋朝就是一個安靜、有文化、有氣質的大家閨秀。但是，這位閨秀最後沒有過上幸福的生活。因為沒有強大的國防，當戰火來臨時，她的優雅生活也就結束了。

sentences.traditional: 宋朝採取了不同於前朝的國家治理方式：
sentences.pinyin: sòng cháo cǎi qǔ le bù tóng yú qián cháo de guó jiā zhì lǐ fāng shì
sentences.english: In order to avoid repeating the story of the downfall of the Tang, which was caused by overly powerful generals, ..

sentences.simplified: 重文轻武，实行文官主政。
sentences.traditional: 重文輕武，實行文官主政。
sentences.pinyin: zhòng wén qīng wǔ shí xíng wén guān zhǔ zhèng
sentences.english: .. the Song dynasty adopted a different approach to governance than its predecessor.

sentences.simplified: 朝廷很重视科举考试，
sentences.traditional: 朝廷很重視科舉考試，
sentences.pinyin: cháo tíng hěn zhòng shì kē jǔ kǎo shì
sentences.english: Emphasizing civil over military affairs, it implemented a system of governance led by civil officials.

sentences.simplified: 给文官高收入、高地位，并确立了“不轻易杀文官”的制度。
sentences.traditional: 給文官高收入、高地位，並確立了“不輕易殺文官”的制度。
sentences.pinyin: gěi wén guān gāo shōu rù gāo dì wèi bìng què lì le bù qīng yì shā wén guān de zhì dù
sentences.english: The imperial court placed great importance on the imperial examination.
They provided civil officials with high income and status and established a system of “not executing civil officials lightly”.

sentences.simplified: 在这样的制度下，宋朝掀起了学习的风潮，文化得到了极大的发展。
sentences.traditional: 在這樣的制度下，宋朝掀起了學習的風潮，文化得到了極大的發展。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè yàng de zhì dù xià sòng cháo xiān qǐ le xué xí de fēng cháo wén huà dé dào le jí dà de fā zhǎn

sentences.simplified: 据统计，中国现在课本中的古代文学，有一半左右是宋代的。
sentences.traditional: 據統計，中國現在課本中的古代文學，有一半左右是宋代的。
sentences.pinyin: jù tǒng jì zhōng guó xiàn zài kè běn zhōng de gǔ dài wén xué yǒu yí bàn zuǒ yòu shì sòng dài de
sentences.english: Under this system, the Song dynasty experienced a surge in learning, and culture saw significant development.

sentences.simplified: 不仅如此，宋朝的商业和科技也非常发达，
sentences.traditional: 不僅如此，宋朝的商業和科技也非常發達，
sentences.pinyin: bù jǐn rú cǐ sòng cháo de shāng yè hé kē jì yě fēi cháng fā dá
sentences.english: According to statistics, about half of the ancient literature in Chinese textbooks today is from the Song dynasty.

sentences.simplified: 世界上最早的纸币就是在宋朝出现的。
sentences.traditional: 世界上最早的紙幣就是在宋朝出現的。
sentences.pinyin: shì jiè shang zuì zǎo de zhǐ bì jiù shì zài sòng cháo chū xiàn de
sentences.english: Moreover, commerce and technology were also highly developed during the Song dynasty.

sentences.simplified: 中国的四大发明中，
sentences.traditional: 中國的四大發明中，
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó de sì dà fā míng zhōng
sentences.english: The world’s earliest paper currency appeared during this period.

sentences.simplified: 火药、活字印刷和指南针都在宋朝得到重大突破。
sentences.traditional: 火藥、活字印刷和指南針都在宋朝得到重大突破。
sentences.pinyin: huǒ yào huó zì yìn shuā hé zhǐ nán zhēn dōu zài sòng cháo dé dào zhòng dà tū pò
sentences.english: Of the four great Chinese inventions, ..

sentences.simplified: 据部分学者估算，宋代的GDP曾占据全球经济总量的约一半，
sentences.traditional: 據部分學者估算，宋代的GDP曾佔據全球經濟總量的約一半，
sentences.pinyin: jù bù fen xué zhě gū suàn sòng dài de 3 céng zhàn jù quán qiú jīng jì zǒng liàng de yuē yí bàn
sentences.english: .. significant breakthroughs in gunpowder, movable type printing, and the compass were achieved during the Song dynasty.

sentences.simplified: 堪称当时世界上最富裕的国家之一。
sentences.traditional: 堪稱當時世界上最富裕的國家之一。
sentences.pinyin: kān chēng dāng shí shì jiè shang zuì fù yù de guó jiā zhī yī
sentences.english: According to estimates by some scholars, the GDP of the Song dynasty once accounted for about half of the world’s total economic output.
This made it one of the wealthiest countries in the world at that time.

sentences.simplified: 然而，在这片文化与经济的繁荣背后，也埋藏着危机。
sentences.traditional: 然而，在這片文化與經濟的繁榮背後，也埋藏著危機。
sentences.pinyin: rán ér zài zhè piàn wén huà yǔ jīng jì de fán róng bèi hòu yě mái cáng zhe wēi jī

sentences.simplified: 由于长时间压制武将，宋朝的军队变得很弱。
sentences.traditional: 由於長時間壓制武將，宋朝的軍隊變得很弱。
sentences.pinyin: yóu yú cháng shí jiān yā zhì wǔ jiàng sòng cháo de jūn duì biàn de hěn ruò
sentences.english: However, crisis lurked behind this cultural and economic prosperity.

sentences.simplified: 为了和平，朝廷不得不经常给北方的民族送“岁币”，
sentences.traditional: 為了和平，朝廷不得不經常給北方的民族送“歲幣”，
sentences.pinyin: wèi le hé píng cháo tíng bù dé bù jīng cháng gěi běi fāng de mín zú sòng suì bì
sentences.english: Due to the long-term suppression of military generals, the Song’s army became very weak.

sentences.simplified: 但始终无法收复失地。
sentences.traditional: 但始終無法收復失地。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shǐ zhōng wú fǎ shōu fù shī dì
sentences.english: In order to maintain peace, the court had to frequently send “annual tribute” to the northern tribes, ..

sentences.simplified: 军队太弱，后来也成了宋朝灭亡的一个重要原因。
sentences.traditional: 軍隊太弱，後來也成了宋朝滅亡的一個重要原因。
sentences.pinyin: jūn duì tài ruò hòu lái yě chéng le sòng cháo miè wáng de yí ge zhòng yào yuán yīn
sentences.english: .. but it was never able to reclaim the lost territories.
The army’s weakness later became an important reason for the downfall of the Song dynasty.

sentences.simplified: “黄袍加身”不仅是一场权力更迭，更深刻地影响了宋朝的国家治理模式。
sentences.traditional: “黃袍加身”不僅是一場權力更迭，更深刻地影響了宋朝的國家治理模式。
sentences.pinyin: huáng páo jiā shēn bù jǐn shì yì cháng quán lì gēng dié gèng shēn kè de yǐng xiǎng le sòng cháo de guó jiā zhì lǐ mó shì

sentences.simplified: 我们可以用拟人化的方式来形容中国不同朝代的风格：
sentences.traditional: 我們可以用擬人化的方式來形容中國不同朝代的風格：
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men kě yǐ yòng nǐ rén huā de fāng shì lái xíng róng zhōng guó bù tóng cháo dài de fēng gé
sentences.english: “Donning the yellow robe” marked not only a change of power but also profoundly influenced the governance model of the Song dynasty.

sentences.simplified: 如果唐朝是热情活泼、喜欢运动的女孩，
sentences.traditional: 如果唐朝是熱情活潑、喜歡運動的女孩，
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ táng cháo shì rè qíng huó po xǐ huan yùn dòng de nǚ hái
sentences.english: We can use personification to describe the styles of different Chinese dynasties:

sentences.simplified: 那么宋朝就是一个安静、有文化、有气质的大家闺秀。
sentences.traditional: 那麼宋朝就是一個安靜、有文化、有氣質的大家閨秀。
sentences.pinyin: nà me sòng cháo jiù shì yí ge ān jìng yǒu wén huà yǒu qì zhì de dà jiā guī xiù
sentences.english: If the Tang dynasty was an enthusiastic and lively girl who loved sports, ..

sentences.simplified: 但是，这位闺秀最后没有过上幸福的生活。
sentences.traditional: 但是，這位閨秀最後沒有過上幸福的生活。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zhè wèi guī xiù zuì hòu méi yǒu guò shàng xìng fú de shēng huó
sentences.english: .. then the Song dynasty was a quiet, cultured, and graceful lady from a noble family.

sentences.simplified: 因为没有强大的国防，当战火来临时，她的优雅生活也就结束了。
sentences.traditional: 因為沒有強大的國防，當戰火來臨時，她的優雅生活也就結束了。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi méi yǒu qiáng dà de guó fáng dāng zhàn huǒ lái lín shí tā de yōu yǎ shēng huó yě jiù jié shù le
sentences.english: However, this lady did not end up living a happy life.

sentence_translations: Donning the Yellow Robe: Rise and Fall of the Song
In the year 960 AD, it had been half a century since the fall of the Tang dynasty.
Due to the warlord divisions at the end of the Tang dynasty, China was still fragmented at that time.
However, the Later Zhou regime in the north was quietly undergoing changes.
During that year, the Khitan people from the north invaded.
The eight-year-old emperor dispatched General Zhao Kuangyin to confront the enemy.
The army stopped to rest when they reached Chenqiao Station.
Zhao Kuangyin gathered his officers and soldiers to discuss the plan for what they would do next.
After eating and drinking his fill, he took a rest.
Not long after, he was awakened by his officers and soldiers shouting, “Long live the Emperor!”
He opened his eyes and found himself wearing a yellow robe that represented the identity of the emperor.
It turned out that many officers and soldiers were worried that the young emperor could not manage his country.
They were even more concerned that the country would fall into chaos once again.
They believed that Zhao Kuangyin was the person who was most capable of protecting the country.
Therefore, they secretly decided to make him the emperor.
Zhao Kuangyin initially did not want to accept, but everyone kept kneeling and shouting, “Long live the Emperor!”
He refused multiple times, but ultimately accepted the arrangement after everyone insisted.
The next day, he returned to the capital of Later Zhou with his army.
He ordered them not to harm members of the imperial family and not to disturb the common people.
With that, he successfully entered Kaifeng and established the Song dynasty.
After Zhao Kuangyin became emperor through “donning the yellow robe”, he immediately initiated plans to unify the entire country.
But gradually, he began to worry:
Since he had become emperor so easily back then, would someone else use the same method to overthrow him in the future?
In the second year, he invited some of his subordinates for a drink.
As he drank, he said somewhat sadly, “Ah! Without you, I couldn’t have become emperor.
But now that I am the emperor, I always have trouble sleeping. It was much easier when I was a general!
His subordinates didn’t understand and asked, “Why can’t Your Majesty sleep well?”
Zhao Kuangyin said, half-drunk and half-awake, “Who wouldn’t want my throne?”
Everyone understood his meaning and expressed their willingness to relinquish their military power and return home to retire.
Zhao Kuangyin then gave them a lot of gold and land, allowing them to retire peacefully.
This is a famous historical event known as “relinquishing military power over a cup of wine”.
In order to avoid repeating the story of the downfall of the Tang, which was caused by overly powerful generals, ..
.. the Song dynasty adopted a different approach to governance than its predecessor.
Emphasizing civil over military affairs, it implemented a system of governance led by civil officials.
The imperial court placed great importance on the imperial examination.
They provided civil officials with high income and status and established a system of “not executing civil officials lightly”.
Under this system, the Song dynasty experienced a surge in learning, and culture saw significant development.
According to statistics, about half of the ancient literature in Chinese textbooks today is from the Song dynasty.
Moreover, commerce and technology were also highly developed during the Song dynasty.
The world’s earliest paper currency appeared during this period.
Of the four great Chinese inventions, ..
.. significant breakthroughs in gunpowder, movable type printing, and the compass were achieved during the Song dynasty.
According to estimates by some scholars, the GDP of the Song dynasty once accounted for about half of the world’s total economic output.
This made it one of the wealthiest countries in the world at that time.
However, crisis lurked behind this cultural and economic prosperity.
Due to the long-term suppression of military generals, the Song’s army became very weak.
In order to maintain peace, the court had to frequently send “annual tribute” to the northern tribes, ..
.. but it was never able to reclaim the lost territories.
The army’s weakness later became an important reason for the downfall of the Song dynasty.
“Donning the yellow robe” marked not only a change of power but also profoundly influenced the governance model of the Song dynasty.
We can use personification to describe the styles of different Chinese dynasties:
If the Tang dynasty was an enthusiastic and lively girl who loved sports, ..
.. then the Song dynasty was a quiet, cultured, and graceful lady from a noble family.
However, this lady did not end up living a happy life.
Because there was no strong national defense, her elegant life came to an end when the flames of war arrived.
